references.text: Detailed instructions for the construction of the courtyard, including dimensions and materials, which Moses is now to set up
Description of how the courtyard was actually made by Bezalel and the craftsmen, with the hangings and the gate
Specific instruction regarding the screen for the courtyard gate, mentioned here as 'masak sha'ar hechatsér'
The hangings of the courtyard and the screen for the gate are listed as part of the tabernacle equipment
The fulfillment of this command, where Moses actually sets up the courtyard around the tabernacle and hangs the screen
The responsibility of the Gershonites for the courtyard hangings and the screen at the entrance, showing the continuation of the service
The description of the Levites' duty to carry the courtyard equipment in v.26 emphasizes the function of the structure Moses sets up in v.8.
The technical specifications for the hangings in v.12 form the physical basis for the setup commanded in v.8.
The making of the sockets and pegs in v.31 is the necessary prerequisite for the setup commanded in v.8.
